title: Dropdown
description: A single-select dropdown with keyboard navigation, async loading, custom triggers, and portal support.

content.description: React.ReactNode - Custom content rendered in the option list.

selectedContent.description: React.ReactNode - Content shown in the trigger when this option is selected.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: (value: string | null, option: DropdownOption | null) => void - Fires when the selected value changes.
onValueChange.x-tsType: ((value: string | null, option: DropdownOption | null) => void) | undefined

defaultOpen.description: Whether the dropdown is initially open (uncontrolled).

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void - Fires when the open state changes.

id.description: HTML id attribute for the trigger element.

name.description: Form field name for the hidden input.

placeholder.description: React.ReactNode - Content displayed when no option is selected.

error.description: Displays the dropdown in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the dropdown.

label.description: React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the dropdown.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Description text rendered below the label.

success.description: Displays the dropdown in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the dropdown.

clearable.description: Shows a clear button to deselect the current value.

emptyContent.description: React.ReactNode - Content shown when no options are available.

showChevron.description: Whether to show the chevron icon in the trigger.

showSelectedIcon.description: Whether to show a check icon next to the selected option.

selectedIcon.description: React.ReactNode - Custom icon for the selected option indicator.

fullWidth.description: Makes the dropdown span the full width of its container.

loadOptions.description: () => Promise<DropdownOption[]> - Async function to load options. Requires `loadOnOpen`; alone it never fires.

loadOnOpen.description: When true, calls loadOptions each time the dropdown opens. Requires `loadOptions`; alone it has nothing to load.

onLoadError.description: (error: unknown) => void - Called when async option loading fails.

shimmerCount.description: Number of shimmer placeholder items shown during loading.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for dropdown sub-elements.

className.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles for the root element.

keepMounted.description: Keeps the dropdown DOM mounted when closed.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null - Portal target for the dropdown popup.

lockScroll.description: Locks body scroll while the dropdown is open.

dropdownSide.description: Vertical placement of the dropdown relative to the trigger.

forceDropdownSide.description: Locks the dropdown to the specified position without auto-flipping.

dropdownOffset.description: Gap in pixels between trigger and dropdown popup.

typeaheadTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for keyboard typeahead matching.

onBlur.description: (event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void - Fires when the trigger loses focus, with the native focus event.

onFocus.description: (event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void - Fires when the trigger takes focus, with the native focus event.

onKeyDown.description: (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void - Fires on keydown events.

renderTrigger.description: (triggerProps: DropdownTriggerRenderProps, state: DropdownTriggerState) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the trigger element. Spread triggerProps onto a <button>; draw from state (isOpen, selectedOption, placeholder).

chevronIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the trigger's chevron. Rendered inside a box carrying `classes.icon`, which turns it over while the menu is open.

clearIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the clear button's glyph. Rendered as given.

loadingContent.description: React.ReactNode - Text shown during async loading.
